# Donkey Ideas

> Donkey Ideas is a comprehensive venture builder platform and operating system that helps entrepreneurs build, manage, and scale ventures.

## About
Donkey Ideas provides an all-in-one operating system for venture builders. The platform includes financial management, project tracking, pitch deck generation, business analytics, AI-powered insights, and strategic tools for entrepreneurs and startups.

## Services
- Venture Building: End-to-end venture creation and management
- Financial Hub: P&L statements, balance sheets, cash flow analysis, budgeting and forecasting
- Analytics: Google Analytics integration with AI-powered recommendations
- Pitch Deck Builder: AI-generated investor presentations
- Whitepaper Generator: Professional documentation for ventures
- Team Management: Collaboration, access control, and activity tracking
- Investor Portal: Investor updates, access management, and reporting
- Valuation Engine: Revenue multiples, DCF, and market comparables
- Project Management: Kanban boards, task tracking, and document library
- AI Assistant: Intelligent business guidance and analysis
